$comment: The landing page (D-174, D-176): visual first, a few words each. The hero, up to five featured sections, and the closing line; the tiles and the buttons are in the view document (packages/views/views/siteLanding.view.json). Each image is the app's own window (apps/desktop/e2e/site-catalog.spec.ts, cut out by tools/site/scenes.py), light mode unless a section says otherwise. The Themes section shows the same note in every built-in theme, chosen by swatches with a Light / Dark switch. WP-10.5 writes the final words.
